shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current && git status --short && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,70p' && git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Validate tool input before execution" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
